texte.strings:appTagline.text: Your digital depot — offline, encrypted, in your hands.
texte.strings:welcomeUnterzeile.text: Contacts, health, finances and provisions — kept with you, accessible to you and, in an emergency, to family or your doctor.
texte.strings:welcomeWeiter.text: What would you like to do?
texte.strings:welcomeDateiOeffnen.text: Already have a depot? Open file
texte.strings:anlegenFehler.text: The depot could not be created. Please try again.
texte.strings:cryptoPwAufforderung.text: Enter the password for your depot
texte.strings:cryptoInternAufforderung.text: Your depot is stored on this device. Enter your password to open it.
texte.strings:cryptoNeuAnfangen.text: Start fresh instead — without a file
texte.strings:welcomeInternVorhanden.text: There is already a depot on this device. Starting a new one leaves it untouched: when you unlock, your password opens the depot it belongs to.
texte.strings:wipeSperrschirmHinweis.text: Your depot was closed because {marke} had not been visible for half an hour. Nothing has been lost.
texte.strings:dateiNichtLesbar.text: This file can't be read — it's corrupted or not a depot file.
texte.strings:fehlerFalsch.text: Decryption failed — wrong password or tampered file.
texte.strings:ortHinweisAllgemein.text: A password for this file is stored: {ort}
texte.strings:dateiErkennungAnker.text: This file is your own depot.
texte.strings:dateiErkennungBlackbox.text: This file was given to you by someone else — open it with the password you were given for it.
